Yale edges out Columbia by 9 for the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus.

All 8 Ivy League schools:

1. Yale: 223
2. Columbia: 214
3. Harvard: 156
4. Brown: 133
5. Penn: 125
6. Princeton: 97
7. Cornell: 69
8. Dartmouth: 39

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/ivy-league/
Florida State has 50 restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus. Florida has 48.
